items.title: Corporate & M&A
items.shortDescription: We advise on mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and corporate structuring to help businesses grow and succeed.
items.subtitle: Strategic Legal Counsel. Lasting Business Impact.
items.introText: We advise on mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and corporate structuring to help businesses grow, transform, and succeed.
items.overviewHtml:
In today's dynamic business environment, strategic corporate decisions can unlock growth, create value, and drive transformation.

Our Corporate & M&A practice provides end-to-end legal support through every stage of your business journey—from structuring and governance to complex transactions and post-merger integration.

We combine legal excellence with commercial insight to deliver solutions that are practical, efficient, and aligned with your business objectives.

items.title: Banking & Finance
items.shortDescription: Our legal expertise supports financial institutions and lenders in navigating regulatory complexities and risks.
items.subtitle: Navigating Financial Regulations Securely.
items.introText: We represent banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, and borrowers in complex financial transactions and restructuring.
items.overviewHtml:
The banking and finance industry operates in an increasingly complex and regulated global environment.

Our dedicated Banking & Finance team advises commercial banks, investment funds, fintech innovators, and corporate borrowers across structured finance, syndicated lending, and debt recovery.

We provide pragmatic, result-oriented legal counsel ensuring full regulatory compliance while enabling seamless financial execution.

services.title: Project & Structured Finance

services.title: Regulatory & Compliance
services.description: Navigating central banking regulations, KYC norms, and anti-money laundering mandates.

services.title: Fintech & Digital Banking
services.description: Legal structuring for payment gateways, digital lending platforms, and crypto-asset compliance.

services.title: Insolvency & Debt Restructuring
services.description: Representing creditors and corporate debtors in insolvency resolution and debt settlements.

approach.title: Regulatory Precision
approach.description: In-depth understanding of banking codes and financial laws.

approach.title: Speed & Agility

approach.title: Asset Protection

items.title: Technology & Telecommunications
items.shortDescription: We help tech companies innovate with confidence while protecting their IP and ensuring regulatory compliance.
items.subtitle: Protecting Innovations in the Digital Era.
items.introText: Guidance for software firms, SaaS platforms, hardware innovators, and tech startups on intellectual property, cybersecurity, and data protection.
items.overviewHtml:
The pace of technological innovation demands legal partners who understand both code and commerce.

We partner with early-stage disruptors and multinational tech enterprises alike, safeguarding core IP assets, crafting cross-border licensing frameworks, and addressing AI regulations.

Our attorneys blend deep tech literacy with rigorous legal acumen to help your company scale securely in global markets.

services.title: Data Privacy & GDPR / DPDP

services.title: Software Licensing & SaaS Contracts

services.title: IP Protection & Tech Transfers

approach.title: IP Security

items.title: Manufacturing & Industrial
items.shortDescription: We provide end-to-end legal support to manufacturers across operations, compliance, and supply chain matters.
items.subtitle: Building a Strong Legal Foundation for Industry.
items.introText: We support industrial manufacturers, automotive giants, and heavy engineering firms across global operations, safety standards, and supply chain logistics.
items.overviewHtml:
Manufacturing operations are subject to rigorous safety, environmental, labor, and international supply chain regulations.

Our Manufacturing team assists industrial clients from initial facility acquisition and environmental clearances to OEM contracting and product liability mitigation.

We ensure that our clients minimize downtime and legal disputes while maintaining competitive manufacturing excellence.

services.title: Supply Chain & Procurement
services.description: Drafting robust vendor agreements, master supply contracts, and logistics partnerships.

services.title: Environmental & Factory Regulations
services.description: Ensuring compliance with emission standards, waste management, and industrial safety norms.

services.title: Labor & Industrial Relations
services.description: Handling union negotiations, workplace safety policies, and employment dispute resolution.

services.title: Product Liability Defense
services.description: Representing manufacturers in warranty disputes, product recall management, and tort claims.

approach.title: Operational Grounding
approach.description: Understanding real-world factory workflows and supply vulnerabilities.

approach.title: Proactive Safety
approach.description: Preventing regulatory violations before they disrupt manufacturing lines.

approach.title: Dispute Containment
approach.description: Swift resolution of supplier and labor disputes without halting production.

matters: Advised an automotive parts manufacturer on establishing a $45M automated production plant.
Structured international supply and distribution contracts for an electronics producer across APAC and Europe.
Successfully resolved a multi-million-dollar supply chain breach dispute through international arbitration.
Secured all regulatory environmental and factory licenses for a new chemical processing facility.

items.title: Healthcare & Life Sciences
items.shortDescription: We guide healthcare providers and organizations on compliance, contracts, and regulatory requirements.
items.subtitle: Legal Care for Healthcare Professionals.
items.introText: Assisting hospital networks, biotech research firms, medical device manufacturers, and telemedicine providers with healthcare law and compliance.
items.overviewHtml:
The healthcare and life sciences landscape is defined by stringent oversight, ethical mandates, and rapid clinical innovation.

Our specialized team advises healthcare organizations on FDA/drug regulatory compliance, medical ethics, patient data privacy (HIPAA/DISHA), and medical malpractice litigation defense.

We provide steadfast counsel that empowers healthcare practitioners and biotech innovators to advance medical science safely.

services.title: Clinical Trials & Drug Approvals
services.description: Structuring clinical trial agreements, investigator contracts, and regulatory filing compliance.

services.title: Medical Device & Biotech IP

services.title: Telemedicine & Digital Health

items.title: Retail & E-Commerce
items.shortDescription: From consumer protection to contract management, we help retailers and e-commerce businesses thrive.
items.subtitle: Legal Solutions for Modern Retail.
items.introText: Protecting retail brands, omnichannel marketplaces, and consumer goods manufacturers in digital and brick-and-mortar ecosystems.
items.overviewHtml:
Modern commerce moves seamlessly across physical storefronts, direct-to-consumer portals, and global online marketplaces.

We counsel leading retail brands on consumer protection compliance, advertising law, e-commerce terms, payments, and international logistics agreements.

Our forward-thinking legal approach helps consumer brands protect their trademark identity and scale sales channels securely.

items.title: Real Estate & Construction
items.shortDescription: We assist in real estate transactions, project development, leasing, and construction law with practical solutions.
items.subtitle: Solid Legal Grounds for Real Estate.
items.introText: Handling high-value land acquisitions, title diligence, RERA compliance, construction contracts, and commercial lease agreements.
items.overviewHtml:
Real estate investments and infrastructure development require ironclad documentation and relentless attention to title clarity.

Our Real Estate & Construction practice represents property developers, institutional investors, REITs, and contractors across the complete project lifecycle.

From initial zoning approvals and land diligence to construction arbitration and commercial leasing, we protect your property investments.

services.title: RERA & Regulatory Approvals

items.title: Energy & Sustainability
items.shortDescription: We support energy companies in regulatory compliance, renewable projects, and sustainable business initiatives.
items.subtitle: Powering Sustainable Legal Strategies.
items.introText: Legal counsel for solar, wind, and hydro renewable projects, power purchase agreements (PPAs), and carbon offset initiatives.
items.overviewHtml:
The global transition to clean energy creates immense opportunities paired with evolving environmental and regulatory mandates.

We advise independent power producers, renewable developers, cleantech startups, and industrial energy consumers on project development, PPAs, and grid connectivity.

Our team brings specialized sector knowledge to navigate green subsidies, environmental impact assessments, and ESG reporting standards.

services.title: Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs)

services.title: Renewable Project Development

services.title: ESG & Carbon Credit Trading

approach.title: Green Innovation
